0022600226.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 6th in the West, 2nd in the Northwest) head to Portland for their 12th game of the season, coming off a loss but riding a 7-3 stretch over their last ten games. The Trail Blazers are 7-3 overall (8th in the West, 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back), are on a win streak, and are without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 123-103 loss in Portland on November 10, though it won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
